v0.1.1:
### New

- Host sessions and control the queue and search from a phone
- Sing along with the lyrics on a full-screen karaoke view
- Queue songs and reorder them in a docked sidebar
- Search YouTube Music directly for songs
- Skip non-music sections of music videos
- Show romaji under lyrics from the View menu
- Follow a count-in of beat dots before each line
- Scroll lyrics in line, page or centre follow modes
- Save and open songs with their separated vocals and lyrics
- Score your singing live with a choice of difficulty
- Update the app from a button in the toolbar
- Control the app with an Android TV remote
- Watch the song's music video behind the lyrics
- Show lyric pitch lines in the karaoke view
- Show two lyric lines at once in the karaoke view

### Improved

- Lyrics are found automatically for covers and unreleased songs
- Furigana now covers more kanji and shows over every lyric line
- Songs are ready sooner because lyric timing runs on the graphics card
- Video and audio from YouTube are now saved in higher quality
- Lyrics highlight slightly ahead so they no longer look late
- Model downloads are optional and show progress in a notification
- Streaming search results show larger thumbnails

### Fixed

- Playhead keeps moving after you press play in the desktop app
- YouTube downloads in the desktop app now play
- Lyric words no longer overlap when you zoom out
- Menus and pickers stay on screen near the window edge
- Escape closes the top dialog again
- Queue tab no longer shows an error when the desktop app starts
- Space toggles play again after you use the seek bar
- Lyrics stay in time when aligned to vocals with an offset
- Failed model setup now says why and the dialog closes
